title: Mission Control event, mc.event/1
description: One activity event: an agent WAL write, a push, a release, a deploy, a ticket checkpoint comment, a chat send, an owner state change, an initiatives update or a system notice. One JSON object per line in file-drop sources. Producers carry ids, kinds, counts and times; summary text is optional and is re-redacted by Mission Control. See docs/mission-control-events.md.

id.description: Stable, producer-prefixed id (e.g. fabric:123, wal:<session>:<agent>:<offset>); replays dedupe on it.

ts.description: UTC time of the underlying activity, RFC 3339 with Z, millisecond precision.

source.description: Producer; Mission Control pins it to the drop file name for external sources.

count.description: How many underlying activities this event stands for (bursts are summarised).

historic.description: Backfill from a first read: shown in history, never pulsed.

quiet.description: Activity without a work item (tool calls, prompts, subagent start/stop): pulses the scene and refreshes ages, but is not a feed row unless the viewer asks for tool activity.
